title: About Shubhankar Shil | Professional Journey & Philosophy
description: Discover Shubhankar Shil’s background in chartered accountancy, higher education, governance and advisory work.

data.heading: A career connecting organizational purpose and human possibility.
data.lead: Shubhankar Shil, FCA, is a chartered accountant, management advisor, university academic, researcher and mentor whose work spans institutional systems, organizational performance and learning.
biography: His background brings together professional accountancy, business education and experience in organizational advisory roles. As Founder and Managing Partner of JKMNS, Chartered Accountants, he works at the intersection of management, assurance, regulatory understanding and organizational development.

Alongside his professional work, Shubhankar has maintained a substantial academic career. His faculty biography at the University of Liberal Arts Bangladesh identifies him as an Assistant Professor with more than two decades of engagement in higher education, including earlier teaching at Independent University, Bangladesh.

He previously held a governance role with the World Bank’s South Asia Region. This combination of organizational practice and higher education informs his interest in leadership, accountability, management systems and building institutions that can sustain their own performance.

Mentorship is another important dimension of his work. The objective is not simply to help a learner reach the next milestone, but to strengthen the judgment and capacity needed for the milestones beyond it.

title: Academia & Research | Shubhankar Shil
description: Explore teaching interests, research themes and selected academic publications by Shubhankar Shil.

data.heading: Developing knowledge that can be questioned, tested and applied.
data.lead: Education must do more than transmit information. It should build analytical judgment, ethical responsibility and the ability to make sense of complex business and institutional problems.
philosophy: In a changing economy, remembering a framework is useful; knowing when it applies is more valuable. Effective teaching brings theory into contact with lived situations, competing evidence and imperfect choices.
This approach values participatory learning, case-based dialogue, thoughtfully designed assessments and explicit learning outcomes.

title: Mentorship & Education | Shubhankar Shil
description: Practical thinking on learning, career readiness and developing professional judgment.

data.heading: Teaching knowledge. Developing judgment. Expanding possibility.
data.lead: Meaningful mentorship helps learners grow the capacity to decide, adapt and contribute—rather than depend on someone else’s answers.
philosophy: There is no single formula for an effective career. Individual circumstances, interests and ambitions differ. But disciplined learning, constructive feedback, communication and the ability to work through ambiguity consistently improve the quality of choices.
A mentor can provide a framework, ask difficult questions and help a learner see beyond an immediate decision. Responsibility for the journey remains with the learner.

pathways.body: Build curiosity, communication, study habits, confidence and the ability to ask useful questions.
Connect academic knowledge with practical work, ethical judgment and informed career exploration.
Strengthen problem-solving, workplace habits, portfolio evidence and interview readiness.
Develop systems thinking, financial literacy, team management and responsible decisions.
